methodology: Record in Office reports raw descriptive measures only and does not calculate an RIEP effectiveness score. Lead-sponsored legislation, cosponsorships, chamber passage, enactment, committee assignments, leadership, and floor-vote participation are kept as separate measures. Ceremonial and memorial resolutions are excluded from headline bill counts. A null value means the measure has not yet been verified and is omitted from display; it never means zero.
